answer: The loom stands in the weaving shed, wool yarn dyed and wound on bobbins. Proof of weaver via wool cloth tally — a cloth the weaver looms only after 45 cloths hold their weave without one snagging at the selvedge, each woven by the weaver herself. pulse warps the loom thread by thread and ties the knots. fable throws the shuttle through and beats the weft tight. timber lifts the cloth off and checks the selvedge all round. Forty-five cloths must hold their weave without one snagging at the selvedge, and the next still snags where the wool ran coarse.
